title: Tuple restriction total map
statement: Let g:Y → X be a scheme morphism, ι a finite index type, U and V indexed open families with all tuple inclusions hinter, I and J injective resolutions of the lifted additive structure sheaves, and α:I → g_*J a cochain map [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization, def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer]. Define each tuple pullback map by inclusion of the target product open into the inverse image source product open, followed by openSectionPullback. Define each bidegree map by source product projection followed by resolutionSectionTransfer at that tuple map. For each n there exists a total cochain map t whose composite with every total summand inclusion (p,q) is this bidegree map followed by the target summand inclusion, and which commutes with the alpha augmentation in degree n. No coefficient augmentation or beta compatibility is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Construct the tuple pullback and bidegree maps by the explicit definitions in Lean. The square for every tuple deletion commutes by equality of the two pullback projections; resolutionSectionTransfer_naturality gives commutation with each face and hence the alternating horizontal differential. The section transfer chain-map equation gives the vertical differential equation. Totalize the resulting double-complex map; ιTotal_map gives the specification on all summands. The square with terminal etale objects commutes by the same projection calculation and gives the alpha equation. This is a map construction without hα or beta compatibility; all summand equations determine t uniquely.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_additiveCech_pullback_total_map
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (J : InjectiveResolution Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (α : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : additiveCechTotal U I ⟶ additiveCechTotal V J,
      IsAdditiveCechPullbackTotalMap g U V hinter I J α t ∧
      (additiveCechAlpha U I n ≫ t.f n =
        (Etale.globalResolutionSectionTransfer g I.cocomplex J.cocomplex α).f n ≫
          additiveCechAlpha V J n)
